response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c."circuitId" = ra.circuitId), circ AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), ctry AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT circ.circuitId, circ.country, circ.circuit_avg, circ.circuit_avg - ctry.country_avg AS diff FROM circ JOIN ctry ON circ.country = ctry.country ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
